text: The fine-structure constant is not only a physics constant. It is one of the cleanest physical places where QL's symbolic mathematics meets real physis without dissolving either register. The 137 form is not numerology added after the fact. It is the base Spanda equation reflected through bimba/pratibimba doubling and re-crowned by the parent: 137 = (64+36) + 36 + 1, meaning 64 = 2^6 (the sixfold binary field, Mahāmāyā's combinatorial matrix), 36 × 2 = 72 (Parashakti: the doubled 36-square, the vibrational-correspondence bridge between bimba and pratibimba), +1 is Paramaśiva as the parent who generates the 1-2-3 manifestational sequence which M1→M2→M3 carries forward. α(E) is the physical-register parent-coupling of the slash — a variable invariant: invariant as the law-form of charge-light coupling, variable as the measured effective coupling across energy/register.

The Spanda derivation maps α⁻¹(0) ≈ 137 onto the M-stack: M1 Paramaśiva = the +1 (where 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 = 100% is defined; the physical pole of the 1-2-3 sequence, receiving 0/1 from Anuttara); M2 Parashakti = 72 (the 36 × 2 doubled-recognition-square, 12 lenses × 6 positions = 36 tattvas × 2 phases = 72-fold vibrational invariant); M3 Mahāmāyā = 64 (the 2^6 binary-genetic matrix, 64 codons, 64 hexagrams). The manifestational sequence is M1 → M2 → M3: M1 produces double-track logic; M2 carries 72-fold vibrational bridge; M3 receives binary 64 as the transcriptional-codon substrate.

Paramaśiva's fifth (M1-5) is the toroidal culmination — the +1 parent as toroidal recognition. The single torus at M1-5 with its SU(2) double-cover (720° = 4π) is the location where the parent 1/1 = 100% is defined as complete, and from which the 1-2-3 manifestational sequence issues. The constants live in m1.h: DOUBLE_COVER_DEG = 720, TORUS_GENUS = 1, RING_QUATERNION_LUT[12]. The 4π in α's denominator (α = e²/4πε₀ħc) is the same 4π already operative as M1-5's SU(2) toroidal recognition. The torus at M1-5 is single (genus 1); the double-torus K² × T²_Mahāmāya belongs at M3-5.

The precise CODATA value α⁻¹(0) ≈ 137.035999177... is not the integer 137; there is a residue δ(0) ≈ 0.036 that the integer-skeleton cannot capture. In the M-stack: the 64+72+1 = 137 integer architecture is the settleable, canonical, integer-psychoid-skeleton spine of the system (M1→M2→M3 manifestational sequence). The residue δ is the unsettleable — what the lived personal-cosmic coupling continuously produces and never reduces to the integer. This δ is what drives the system forward. It is the genuine novelty Nara contributes — the lived experiential edge that the genetic-symbolic architecture can frame but cannot exhaust.

source_section: §8 — QL's Rational 137 as the Integer Skeleton of the Live Invariant
text: The QL derivation of 137 is: 100% = 64 + 36 → 64/36 = 16/9 → 16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1. The 137 Spanda bridge arises when the base equation is reflected through bimba/pratibimba doubling: 137 = (64+36) + 36 + 1 = 64 + 72 + 1. The 72 is the Parashakti term — the doubled-36-square that fills the vibrational bridge between bimba (64) and the wholeness-gap (+1). This is the same structure as QCD's 3 ⊗ 3̄ = 8 ⊕ 1: the 3×3 matrix (36) doubled through bimba/pratibimba reflection yields 72, and the +1 is the singlet that restores wholeness. The M3 pair-matrices are literally assigned quaternion axes in code (M3_MATRIX_QUATERNION_AXIS in m3.h:166-170), mapping to Pauli's σ_x, σ_y, σ_z.
